evidence.metric: V-posterior projection through V's Gaussian mass kernel (within 3 sigma). Radius scales with sqrt projected support. Teal marks at least 4-fold support or support only in one candidate. Neither radius nor color is a calibrated correctness probability.

mma.scope: Two selected drawable neutral skeletal motifs indexed under the ion-formula key in the four mined HMDB source shards. Counts are exact unique-group counts within those shards, not post-merge retrieval weights. Formula and mass labels belong to the ion key, not the neutral RDKit drawings.

construction.scope: Upstream illustration states, separately annotated; an original beam parent chain was not retained in the case ranking file.
construction.reference_replay_scope: Reference-conditioned deterministic action replay using drawn motif entries; not a historical beam rollout or a deployed checkpoint trace.

limitations: Reported ranks are from the same archived scored candidate pool. No claim that the exact W/V comparison was sufficient to establish the structure.
MMA graph alignment uses the source motif and depicted partial graph. Attention operations are schematic; no trained attention weights are shown.
One measured case anchors the upper figure. The lower data-stream examples are independent records.
The bounded controller depicts implemented decision and evaluation logic. No measured autonomous performance is shown.
